title: L1 SOC ANALYST
description:
About The Role
KVG is looking for an L1 SOC Analyst to become the first line of security monitoring for a Microsoft-based environment spanning Moldova, Romania, Ukraine, Germany, Spain, the Philippines, and the United States. You will own the daily triage of alerts in Microsoft Sentinel and Microsoft Defender XDR, and the review of the Microsoft 365 email quarantine - deciding what is real, what is noise, and what needs to go up the chain.
This is a structured entry point into security operations. You will work to documented runbooks and a clear action mandate, alongside our Cloud Security Engineer, in an environment with genuine compliance weight behind it (NIST SP 800-171 and CMMC 2.0). We fund your certification path and expect you to grow into L2 analysis.
What You Will Do

• Monitor and triage incidents in Microsoft Sentinel and Microsoft Defender XDR, working in order of severity.

• Decide whether an alert is a true positive, a false positive, or benign - and write down why.

• Review the Defender for Office 365 quarantine, handle user-reported phishing, and action release or block decisions.

• Analyse message headers, SPF/DKIM/DMARC results, URLs, and attachments to reach a defensible verdict.

• Run pre-built KQL queries in Advanced Hunting to work out who and what was affected.

• Apply runbook-defined containment: revoke sessions, block sign-in, isolate a device, purge a delivered message.

• Escalate anything beyond your mandate with a clear timeline, the evidence, and what you already did.

• Keep case records that hold up under audit, and hand over cleanly at the end of each shift.

• Flag noisy detections and recurring false positives so they can be tuned out.

What We Are Looking For
Required

• 1+ year in IT support, service desk, systems administration, or a security operations role. Strong candidates with certifications and demonstrable lab work will be considered without commercial security experience.

• Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and a cloud-first or hybrid environment.

• Networking and mail flow fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, SMTP, MX records, VPN, firewall concepts.

• Windows and macOS fundamentals - processes, logons, and where the logs live.

• Understanding of common attack techniques: phishing, credential theft, MFA fatigue, token theft, malware delivery.

• Professional written and verbal English. Case notes and escalations are written in English.

• The discipline to follow a runbook exactly, and the judgement to escalate early rather than improvise.

Preffered

• Hands-on exposure to Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR, Defender for Office 365, or Entra ID.

• Ability to read and adapt a KQL query, or basic PowerShell.

• CompTIA Security+ or Microsoft SC-900.

• Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK.

• Awareness of NIST SP 800-171, CMMC 2.0, or GDPR.

What KVG Offers

• Funded Microsoft certification path - SC-200 is the target credential for this role, with the exam paid by KVG .

• A defined progression route from L1 triage to L2 analysis.

• A single-vendor Microsoft security stack: Sentinel, Defender XDR, Entra ID, Intune, Purview - depth rather than tool sprawl.

• Direct mentoring from the Cloud Security Engineer rather than an anonymous alert queue.

• European business-hours coverage with rotational extended-hours support for other regions. This is not a 24/7 shift rotation.

Professional Competencies
Collaborative Spirit | Results Above All | Innovation as a Habit | Creative Freedom | Financial Prudence | Eternal Learner | Daring Adventures | Open Feedback | Integrity in Action | Embrace Change | Accountability

description:
Emerald Zebra , on behalf of our client, a global regulated trading and fintech group, is looking to hire a Group Product Manager to lead its Engagement tribe, covering Trading and Loyalty. The role can be remote, or hybrid from one of the group's offices in Cyprus, the UAE or the UK.
The Role
Our client is taking its own trading platform to mass market. You'll lead the Engagement tribe and report to the VP of Product, with two to three domain Product Managers reporting to you. You'll own the tribe's strategy, its key results and the development of its Product Managers.
Today the tribe objective has no single owner, and trading and loyalty are planned separately even though clients experience them as one thing. You'll change that: set the direction, bring the work together around shared goals and build a team that decides without escalating.
What You'll Do

• Take the platform to market: decide what ships first, who gets it, what ready means and how existing traders move over without losing their habits or trust.

• Own the tribe's key results outright. When a number is flat, surface it early and change something.

• Run loyalty as a retention system, not a rewards catalogue. Work out which tiers, points, missions, challenges and referrals actually change behaviour, and drop the rest.

• Develop the Product Managers so they get materially better within a year at framing problems, using evidence, talking to clients and making decisions.

• Set a three-year direction for how a funded client becomes a habitual, confident trader, with quarterly bets that organise the work.

• Run the portfolio across trading and loyalty: sequence, trade off and stop what isn't working.

• Build a culture of experimentation and rapid release, balanced with a few protected long-term bets.

• Bring dealing, risk, compliance, commercial and marketing in early enough to shape decisions.

Qualifications and Experience

• A B2C trading background. Candidates with a B2B product background will not be considered.

• Has taken a product from zero to launch and on to real adoption, ideally in a business with existing clients and revenue to protect.

• Has owned an engagement, retention or monetisation outcome with a number attached, on a CFD or multi-asset trading platform.

• Real depth in the trading experience: order entry, risk controls, charting, signals, and how trader behaviour differs between a third-party terminal and a proprietary platform.

• Has run retention mechanics and developed junior Product Managers.

• Has raised a team's release and experiment cadence from a low base.

• Commercial fluency in how engagement converts to value: ARPU, retention and what incentives cost.

• Can move compliance, risk and commercial teams without formal authority, and write a strategy from a blank page.

• Loyalty and rewards mechanics at scale, progression or gamification systems, or building experimentation infrastructure, are an asset.

The Type of Person We're Looking For

• A strategic thinker who adds features that generate revenue.

• Hands-on, with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Talks to clients directly, from beginners through to high-value traders.

• A problem solver who can take the product to the next level.

Package and Benefits

• Salary: EUR 6,000 to 8,000 gross per month

• Annual performance bonus

• Monthly cash flex benefit (taxable)

• Hybrid working for office-based hires: 3 days in the office and 2 days from home

• 30 days per year remote working policy

• 40 days annual leave including public holidays

• Private medical insurance, 100% covered for the employee and 50% for dependents

• Work permit support and costs covered for candidates based in Cyprus who need one
